diagnosis: Export job EXP-40233 (~6 GB, eu-central) has been running roughly seven hours, which exceeds the expected completion window for jobs under 10 GB and indicates a stalled job rather than a slow one. Per kb-0005 the remedy is to cancel and resubmit the job; region availability (kb-0008) is unrelated since export queueing is per region. No entitlement gap applies — data_export is present on this enterprise account.
reply: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the trouble. Based on the job size and the amount of time it has been running, EXP-40233 appears to have stalled rather than simply running slowly. Our guidance for export jobs of this size is to cancel the current job and submit it again; the resubmitted job will queue in your region and should complete normally. If the new job also stalls, let us know and we will take a closer look at the export queue for eu-central.
